result.instructions: toolscript connects to other MCP servers. Find their tools with search_tools, then call them from one JavaScript program with run_code: only what the program returns comes back. Prefer run_code to their direct tools for several calls, a write and its check, or a part of a large result.

tools.name: run_code

code.description: Body of an async JavaScript function.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find the tools of the MCP servers that toolscript connects to, to call them in run_code. Give keywords (for example "jira issue create"); get the matching tool names, their descriptions and argument types, and the servers that failed to connect. An empty query lists the servers, and "Not connected" the ones still down after a reconnect. A server key lists its tools.

query.description: Keywords; empty lists every MCP tool.
